lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for single-test change kinds (adoption layout, choose_path hint, choose_path layout, home layout, home new_screen, sign_in incentive, sign_in layout).
Adoption redesigns, sign-in hints, home waiting info, and home notifications were helpful, yielding multiple winning tests.
Copy changes on path selection (choose_path copy) and finish screens (finish copy), along with adding new finish screens (finish new_screen), consistently hurt performance.
Home redesigns, home hints, and finish hints consistently showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Predictions were generally too high overall, but underestimated surprising winning layout, hint, and new screen changes.

candidates.title: List layout redesign for friend selection screen
candidates.change: Redesign the friend selection screen into a list layout featuring pet previews and direct selection controls.
candidates.why: Adoption step takes median 89s / mean 1017s. Past results show adoption redesigns significantly boost user progression.

guard.reason: Redesigning friend selection into a list layout retains pet choice functionality within onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Adoption redesigns have a strong track record of positive impact across 15 historical tests.

candidates.title: OAuth service status hint on sign-in screen
candidates.change: Display a dynamic authentication status hint below sign-in options to reassure users when sign-in loading delays occur.
candidates.why: Sign-in mean duration is 567s and support received emails reporting authentication screens stalling or failing to load.

sign_in.hint: Authentication service connected. If the login window takes a moment to load, your progress is safe.

guard.reason: Adding a dynamic sign-in status hint reassures users without breaking sign-in functionality or onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Both support logs and duration metrics highlight this issue, and sign-in hints consistently perform well.

candidates.title: Pet character personality quiz screen
candidates.change: Insert an interactive pet personality quiz screen right before friend selection to recommend ideal pets based on user answers.
candidates.why: Adoption stage has a high mean completion time (1017s); offering guided recommendations accelerates companion selection.

new_pet_quiz.headline: Find Your Ideal Pet Match
new_pet_quiz.body: Answer two quick questions so we can recommend the perfect companion traits for your desktop.

guard.reason: Inserting a new pet personality quiz screen inside onboarding is allowed under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Adding new screens can add friction despite high duration on the target step.

candidates.title: Asset extraction progress breakdown on waiting screen
candidates.change: Enable detailed progress tracking and time estimates on the waiting screen while desktop pet assets prepare.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a long mean completion time (2336s). Detailed wait information has proven effective in prior iterations.

waiting.hint: Unpacking pet animations and sound assets for desktop rendering...

guard.reason: Adding progress breakdown and time estimates to the waiting screen provides real progress info permitted under rules 4 and 5.

candidates.score_note: Home wait_info interventions show consistent positive lifts across 5 historical tests.

candidates.title: System tray readiness callout notification on waiting screen
candidates.change: Add an optional system notification toggle on the waiting screen that alerts users as soon as loading completes.
candidates.why: Home waiting duration exhibits long tails (mean 2336s). Notification toggles keep users engaged without abandoning the app.

waiting.hint: Enable desktop notification to get notified immediately when your pet is ready to emerge.

guard.reason: Adding an optional system notification toggle on the waiting screen is an allowed onboarding enhancement.

candidates.score_note: Home notifications consistently provide a solid boost across 4 prior tests.

candidates.title: Reorder sign-in after pick friend selection screen
candidates.change: Move sign-in step to take place immediately after choosing a pet companion, prior to photo upload and adoption certificate.
candidates.why: Placing sign-in after pet choice leverages high emotional attachment to complete account registration earlier.

guard.reason: Moving the sign-in step after picking a friend is explicitly allowed under rule 4 without removing any steps.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in reordering shows 0.0% historical lift across 3 past tests.

candidates.title: Pet voice preview flow screen
candidates.change: Insert a voice and sound preview screen following photo upload so users can sample audio traits before signing the certificate.
candidates.why: Support logs reveal user confusion about pet interactions and sounds. Adding voice preview builds clarity and commitment.

new_sound_preview.headline: Choose Your Pet's Voice
new_sound_preview.body: Listen to sound samples and pick the audio personality for your desktop pet.

guard.reason: Adding a voice preview sub-flow screen before adoption certificate is permitted under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Addresses user support issues but introducing new flow steps risks adding drop-off.

candidates.title: Centered layout redesign for friend selection screen
candidates.change: Update the friend selection screen to use a centered focus layout emphasizing pet selection choices.
candidates.why: Adoption layout improvements have consistently driven conversion gains in earlier experiments.

guard.reason: Updating layout to centered focus on the friend selection screen preserves functionality and stays within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Adoption layout changes have limited evidence and slightly negative past performance.

candidates.title: Carousel layout redesign for home intro screen
candidates.change: Redesign the home intro screen into an interactive carousel highlighting key desktop pet controls and tips.
candidates.why: Finish step conversion drops to 69.9% (mean 5815s), and support received multiple emails asking how to control or hide pets.

guard.reason: 'home_intro.replace.home_welcome[0]': a tip_carousel cannot do the home_welcome job (use ['animation', 'button', 'checklist', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'])

candidates.title: Compact layout redesign for choose path screen
candidates.change: Rebuild the path selection screen with a compact layout to display quick preset choices clearly without scrolling.
candidates.why: Choose path has a mean duration of 514s; presenting path options in a streamlined layout helps users decide faster.

guard.reason: Using a compact layout for the path selection screen retains both adopt and make-your-own options as required.

candidates.score_note: Choose_path layout changes lack strong positive evidence and tend to yield neutral or negative lift.

lessons_next: Evidence remains thin for single-test change kinds (adoption layout, choose_path hint, home layout, home new_screen, sign_in incentive, sign_in layout).
Adoption redesigns and sign-in hints were helpful, generating multiple winning tests.
Home waiting info and home notifications proved helpful by yielding winning tests, though several tests showed no clear effect.
Copy changes on path selection (choose_path copy) and finish screens (finish copy), along with adding new finish screens (finish new_screen), consistently hurt performance.
Home redesigns, home hints, finish hints, choose_path layouts, and finish redesigns consistently showed no clear effect across tests.
Predictions were generally too high overall, but underestimated unexpected winning layout, hint, and wait info changes.
